text: Founding hints say 'Open ground lies about 110 to the north-east / 211 to the east / 300 to the south-west' but there is no compass or map on screen, so the player cannot tell which way NE is. Took 5 F attempts and dead-reckoning from state.json x/z to find legal ground (seed 103, tick 125315-129199).
Settlement Info panel truncates 'Next (K): Farm, 25 wood, 10...' - the cost of the next building is cut off at the right edge (960x540).

Objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left: shows 'bers 1/10 - Buildings 1/2' instead of 'Members 1/10'. Inventory Info panel also jumped to screen centre over the world view after entering settlement.

First NPC hunger death of the winter: 'Hunger claimed Stan Thompson of Fortwood within the walls.' at tick 196582 (~25.6k ticks / 8.5 game-min into winter, which began tick 171002). No status line, toast or chronicle entry warned that Fortwood was short of food or that anyone was starving beforehand; the only food warning in the whole run was the generic 'Winter comes tomorrow. Lay in food' at tick 141002.

Winter (tick 171002-231003) ended with 16 NPC hunger deaths across 7 nations (Upperville 5, Fortwood 4, Fortresston 2, Yellowshire 2, Forttown/Blueburg/Southernville 1 each), every one 'within the walls' of a settlement. Deaths only appear as chronicle lines mixed in with raids and stalls; there is no per-settlement food meter, famine warning, or alert before the first death, and pawns' hunger/energy is not visible on screen. Meanwhile trees kept giving apples in winter so the player never went hungry (apples 30->41).
